subject: history
concept: Comparing two ancient civilizations and identifying similarities and differences
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts fact cards from two civilizations into 'same' and 'different' piles
exercise.pictorial: Student fills in a simple venn diagram comparing two ancient civilizations
exercise.abstract: Student writes 1-2 sentences comparing two studied ancient civilizations

assessment.mastery_threshold: identifies at least 2 real similarities and 2 real differences
misconception_flags: treats every difference between the civilizations as a similarity or vice versa

interest_binding: civilizations generated fresh based on prior units, cross-referenced with student's stated interest profile where possible
